thread:
alice: quick results from the async-metasync canary on stg-2 (magnet-16k int4): noticeable p95 improvement during long-prefill runs.
ben: nice, numbers?
alice: single-host loop, 100 iterations prefill=10k tokens, batch=1:
- master: p50 34ms, p95 220ms, fingerprint-fail 0/100
- canary-async: p50 18ms, p95 58ms, fingerprint-fail 0/100
carla: that's a big tail win. did you see any difference in KV churn (evictions/rehashes)?
alice: evictions slightly up (+2%), but no key-miss on reads. evict log sample:
```
[2024-04-12T09:23:10Z] shard=7 evict_count=14 keys_rehashed=6
[2024-04-12T09:23:10Z] prefill_check fingerprint_before=0x7a3c9b21 fingerprint_after=0x7a3c9b21
```
jamal: good that fingerprints match. what about memcpy/blocking syscalls causing the old tail?
mira: i instrumented syscalls: master had sporadic blocking on rpc_send() while the canary did async fire-and-forget with a watchdog that promoted to sync at 250ms. only 3 promotions in 100 loops.
ben: any change to generation correctness? long-context test with known RoPE-sensitive probe (anchor tokens -> expected token offsets)
alice: ran the anchor probe 500 times. master vs canary token divergence count:
- master: 4/500 divergent sequences (rare)
- canary-async: 5/500 divergent sequences
carla: that's within noise. can you paste one divergent diff?
alice: small example (excerpt):
```
prompt: <anchor-1024> ...
expected token @pos 4096 = 0x5a
master out @pos 4096 = 0x5a
canary out @pos 4096 = 0x5b   <-- off by 1
```
mira: looks like an int4 pack/unpack rounding artifact when warmstarting the KV windows under heavy prefill. not obviously caused by async metasync, but co-occurring on this bringup.
jamal: good callout. propose we merge async metasync (clear latency and small tail wins) and track the RoPE drift in a separate triage. open a follow-up issue for quant packing warmstart.
benn: (typo) ben: +1 to merge canary with feature-flag and extended telemetry.
carla: tests to add before ship:
- unit: delayed-rpc path with fingerprint assertion
- e2e: 10k token prefill smoke with anchor-probe diffs logged
- load: 20-host canary run for 2h with promotion rate metrics
alice: I'll push the feature-flagged merge and add telemetry hooks. jamal can you own the follow-up for int4 warmstart packing?
jamal: yep, will start a bisect on the int4 packer and add deterministic fuzz harness.
deploy-bot: rollout/magnet-16k-int4-canary -> promoted to stg-2 (3/6 hosts)
alice: will update after the 2h load run completes. thanks all :thumbsup:
